heading: Demonstrating Impact: Our Success Stories
intro: We believe in the power of data to drive tangible results. While specific client engagements are confidential, these representative case studies illustrate the types of challenges we solve and the value we deliver within the energy and utilities sector.

studies.title: Solar Data Transformation
studies.excerpt: A unified data platform safeguarded €2 million in revenue and boosted forecasting accuracy.
studies.detail: Faced with siloed SCADA, meter, and satellite data that impaired decision‑making and exposed compliance risks, we implemented a standardized governance framework, advanced P50/P90 simulation models, and a scalable AWS–Snowflake data lake. The result was a 20 % improvement in revenue forecasts, a 30 % reduction in compliance findings, and real‑time KPI dashboards that preserved €2 million in potential losses.

studies.title: Cloud Analytics Migration
studies.excerpt: Migrating legacy data lakes to AWS cut over USD 1 million in costs and halved query times.
studies.detail: To eliminate rising licensing fees for legacy cloud platforms and improve analytics performance, we led an Agile squad to rebuild pipelines using Redshift, Glue, Lambda, and S3, while slimming an 8 billion‑row dataset to 200 million for BI. The new serverless architecture delivered a 40 % faster dashboard experience, over USD 1 million in annual savings, and a 60 % surge in self‑service BI adoption.

studies.title: Postal Analytics Revamp
studies.excerpt: Interactive WebI reports drove two new product launches and lifted revenue accuracy.
studies.detail: With outdated reporting hindering visibility on mail volumes and revenue leakage, we designed and delivered end‑to‑end SAP BusinessObjects WebI dashboards alongside a “Dictionary”‑style user guide. Business users gained real‑time delivery forecasts, identified revenue protection opportunities, and launched two customer‑facing services, resulting in substantive top‑line growth.
